note: Input prompt sizes for one live interview turn, measured by instrumenting LLMClient.stream during a real text-mode interview against the deterministic offline engine. No API calls were made. Token figures use the ~4 characters/token approximation.
groq_output_ceiling_note: Raised from the requested max_tokens because gpt-oss reasoning tokens count against it; see LLMClient.MIN_REASONING_MAX_TOKENS.
caveat: This is a worst case: max_tokens is a ceiling, not a charge, so a turn whose reply is short costs less. It is the right figure for deciding whether a back-to-back run will be throttled, which it was: a measured 16-turn run on the free tier returned 21 HTTP 429s and the retry backoff stretched one first-token time to 18 seconds.
